title: Aureline M5 blocked-or-escalate card
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for a blocked-or-escalate card. Names the object class, its change-intent association, the blocker cause, the escalation path, the blocker state, and the retained local notes / linked evidence — so no local notes, handoff packet, or linked evidence is dropped when a provider write fails. Downstream the blocked-or-escalate card, work-item detail, help / docs, and support / export packets point at this schema instead of restating a blocker by hand. Secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
